title: GTA 6 Leaker Posts Grainy Footage Of Lucia Skydiving Naked To Sell Crypto
summary: Cyberleek is more Lucia 'nudes' if $Cyberleek coin keeps going up
text: GTA 6 Leaker Posts Grainy Footage Of Lucia Skydiving Naked To Sell Crypto Skip to content Kotaku Latest Entertainment Reviews News Tips & Guides Games Downloads Deals News GTA 6 Leaker Posts Grainy Footage Of Lucia Skydiving Naked To Sell Crypto Cyberleek is more Lucia 'nudes' if $Cyberleek coin keeps going up Cyberleek Grand Theft Auto 6 Grand Theft Auto VI GTA 6 Leaks Lucia Rockstar Games By Ethan Gach Published October 11, 2026 | Comments ( 12 ) | 𝕏 Copied! Rockstar Games After going quiet for over a month following the Grand Theft Auto 6 extended reveal on Netflix , the account Cyberleek has been busy over the last few days with fresh gameplay leaks and threats. The unknown user claimed they would release a playable build of the game if their crypto meme coin hit a $30 million market cap, and they’re now posting footage of Lucia naked to try to drive up the price. The latest leak shows the game’s female lead driving around the city, engaging in hand-to-hand combat, and visiting an ATM. It also spends a significant amount of time with the Parachuting side mission and mini-games teased in the previous gameplay reveal . The footage also looks janky in parts, leaving viewers to wonder just how old the build it’s from is.market cap The latest Lucia footage comes as the leaker polls people online for what should be released next. They’re promising to release longer and more detailed versions of “ naked Lucia ” the more people buy into their crypto scheme. Cyberleek reveals that he has access to Lucia fully naked in GTA 6, and will publish the footage depending on his token’s marketcap. He’s using this tactic to manipulate people into his pump-and-dump crypto scheme again, so beware. pic.twitter.com/6q0PmoVOIA - GTA 6 Countdown ⏳ (@GTAVI_Countdown) October 10, 2026 The existing theory is that Cyberleek is using some sort of older build or debug mode to show off the game’s two protagonists without any clothes on, and that it’s unclear if this is a thing that can happen in the actual story campaign itself. Bystanders in the world don’t react to Lucia being naked in the latest leak, suggesting something else is indeed going on . Whatever the account has access to, it’s threatening to release it if enough people buy its $Cyberleek meme coin. It’s currently at a market cap of around $4.75 million , up significantly since the leaker’s apparent return. But that’s still a very long way from $30 million. The account has also claimed that Take-Two can avoid a threatened release of some version of GTA 6 if it releases a disc version of the game and “apologizes” to players. Any semblance of some pro-consumer stance has been undercut by the preparation for another attempt at a crypto rug pull. The last time Cyberleek went quiet, the account seemingly made off with roughly $250,000 in dumped crypto . With just over a month until GTA 6’s release, it’s not gunning for a much bigger payday. 🕹️ Level up your inbox Don’t miss the latest reviews, news and tips. Sign up for our free newsletter.
